question: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?

observed_information.statement: A headstone engraved 'SHERLOCK HOLMES' is shown among flowers in v1.
A man on a rooftop makes a phone call while another man on the ground listens with a worried expression.
A man is carried on a stretcher in a dark room and a close-up shows his face on a medical tray.
A man in a beanie crouches over a prone figure near a medical case containing a silicone mask and a syringe.
A man in a black coat falls backward from a ledge, is covered by a white sheet or bag, and lands amid shattered glass.
A crowd is gathered around a body lying on pavement in v2.
Two men discuss whether the body was Sherlock or someone else wearing a mask.
A grey-haired man walks away from a coffee cart while a news reporter references police investigations.
Subtitles report police investigations confirming Richard Brook was a creation of James Moriarty and show Sherlock being cleared.
Two men outside discuss Sherlock's death from Bart's Hospital and toast absent friends.
A cemetery headstone engraved 'SHERLOCK HOLMES' is visited by a man and by two figures holding hands.
Thermal and night-vision views track a human figure moving through a dark forest.

working_relations.statement: The ledge fall in v1 and the pavement body in v2 both depict a public incident involving a fallen figure.
The medical mask and syringe in v1 are connected to the mask-and-body debate in v2.
The Sherlock Holmes headstone appears in both v1 and v2 cemetery scenes.
The hospital-death discussion in v2 relates to the stretcher and medical tray imagery in v1.
The police and courtroom vindication in v2 occurs after the rooftop and fall events in v1.

unresolved_issues.issue: The identity of the person who falls in v1 and the identity of the body in v2 remain unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: Neither report visually confirms the face or a mask on the fallen person or body.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the silicone mask and syringe were used to stage a death remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v1 does not show their application and v2 does not visually confirm a mask on the body.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether friends discovered hidden evidence about police corruption remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The supplied events show police investigation scenes but no event shows friends obtaining or revealing corruption evidence.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether police uncovered the detective's criminal double life remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The v2 reports state that Sherlock is cleared but do not show the missing interval's police findings about a double life.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether a rival investigator exposed the detective's past mistakes remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: No supplied event identifies a rival investigator or shows an exposure of past mistakes.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether allies planted false clues in the cemetery remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The cemetery headstone scenes do not show clue planting or altered evidence.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether grief-stricken friends accidentally destroyed crucial evidence remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The white sheet or bag is not identified as evidence and its damage is not shown.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the head and face visible in the fallen-man shot in v1 with the head and face visible in the pavement-body shot in v2 to determine whether they show the same person or a masked figure.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether the fallen person and the body are the same identity.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the silicone mask and syringe in the v1 medical case with any mask or syringe visible on the v2 body or in the v2 discussion shots to determine whether the props were applied to the body.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether medical props staged a death.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare any object or document held during the v1 rooftop scenes with items shown during the v2 police and courtroom overlay to determine whether hidden police-corruption evidence is visually present.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether friends discovered hidden evidence about police corruption.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the man falling from the ledge in v1 with the vindicated Sherlock figure in the v2 courtroom overlay to determine whether the police findings reveal a double life.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether police uncovered the detective's criminal double life.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the two men at the v2 coffee cart with the men in the v1 rooftop scenes to determine whether one is a rival investigator exposing past mistakes.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether a rival investigator exposed the detective's past mistakes.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the ground and headstone surroundings in the v1 cemetery reveal with the ground and headstone surroundings in the v2 cemetery visits to determine whether false clues were planted.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether allies planted false clues in the cemetery.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the white sheet or bag thrown over the falling man in v1 with the covering or debris around the body in v2 to determine whether evidence was accidentally destroyed.
candidate_requests.purpose: Resolve whether grief-stricken friends accidentally destroyed crucial evidence.
